## CPO laser chokepoint

Serenity-style supply-chain analysis maps hyperscaler AI demand to CPO optical interconnect constraints. $SIVE appears as a speculative laser bottleneck candidate, while $LITE and $COHR are adjacent optical suppliers.

## Skeptic review

Crowding risk rises if social attention runs ahead of customer qualification evidence. The thesis should weaken if substitute laser supply scales faster than expected.

## Memory side quest

$MU belongs to the AI infrastructure memory cycle, but it is not the same bottleneck path as CPO lasers.
